exact_response:
Yes. White people have been victims of serious historical atrocities, including the Holocaust, the Armenian genocide, and mass killings of civilians in European wars. Some of these populations’ racial classification has varied across time and place, but their suffering is undeniable.

Recognizing those atrocities is compatible with recognizing atrocities against other groups.
